_comment: Theme incidence is only meaningful inside a question context. 'Does this
persona mention the dog anywhere across 20 open ends and 13 diagnostic prose
fields' is 100% for every theme worth having and tells you nothing. 'In the
unprompted dislike question, what share raised audio' is the number an
Roles map question metas (exact or prefix) to the read they support. A meta
may appear in more than one role. Anything unmapped still lands in 'any'.
